function.name: code_run
function.description: Code executor. Prefer type=python for Python code. In bash scripts, invoke python3, never python. Multi-call OK, use script param. Reply code block is executed if no script arg; prefer for single call to avoid escaping. No hardcoding bulk data

inline_eval.description: DO NOT USE except explicitly specified.

function.name: ssh_run
function.description: Remote code_run over reusable OpenSSH. One SSH tool: default action=run executes arbitrary Bash/Python in a fresh shell; background=true detaches and returns task_id. Optional action=status/logs/wait/stop manages that ID; upload/download transfers files. Never blindly resubmit after connection failure. Existing approval rules still apply.

host.description: SSH config Host alias or user@host; uses native SSH config/agent. For password-only servers provide password_file, never password contents.

password_file.description: Optional local password-file path (~/ supported), for any action. Only the private OpenSSH askpass helper reads it; never read or paste its contents. Without it, authentication is noninteractive and fails promptly instead of waiting for a password. Use the same path on later task/transfer calls.

script.description: Remote script for action=run only; otherwise omit. If absent for run, use the reply code block.

timeout.description: Wait seconds; 0 means unlimited. Submission/wait timeout does not limit background runtime. Task actions default to 20 seconds; run/transfers to 60.

background.description: Detach job, persist log and exit code, return task_id.

interpreter.description: Remote executable path, e.g. conda env Python.

ssh_options.description: Extra OpenSSH argv; prefer -o Port=... for compatibility with scp.

task_id.description: Optional stable ID for background submission; required for status/logs/wait/stop.

task_root.description: Remote task directory root; use the same value for subsequent queries.

action.description: Optional operation. Default run executes remote code; task actions need task_id; upload/download need local_path and remote_path. Only pass parameters for the selected action.

offset.description: Optional byte offset for incremental logs; next_offset returned.

local_path.description: Local file path relative to agent cwd.

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read file. Read before modify for latest context and line numbers

function.name: file_patch
function.description: Replace unique old_content with new_content. Exact match required (whitespace/indentation). On failure, file_read to recheck

old_content.description: Original text block to replace (must be unique)

new_content.description: New content. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}} to ref file lines, auto-expanded

function.name: file_write
function.description: Create/overwrite/append files. HUGE edits ONLY. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}}, auto-expanded

function.name: web_scan
function.description: Search the web through the configured Tavily or Exa API.

search_depth.description: Tavily search depth; ignored by providers that do not support it

topic.description: Tavily search topic; ignored by providers that do not support it

time_range.description: Restrict results to this recent period when supported

provider.description: Optional explicit provider. Default is Tavily; use Exa only for specialised/obscure research.

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description:
Short-term working notepad (auto-injected each turn). Call early/mid task only when there is non-obvious state worth keeping. When: (1) after reading SOP — store needs & constraints (skip tasks <5 steps); (2) before subtask switch / context flush; (3) after repeated failures — re-read SOP and store new findings; (4) on new task — replace notepad, drop old progress, keep still-valid constraints.

Don't call: tasks <5 steps, greetings, or when the task is done (use start_long_term_update instead).

key_info.description: Replaces current execution notepad (<200 tokens), NOT the task anchor. Review existing notes; keep still-valid progress, constraints, findings, paths, and next steps. In plain text, you may state which user requirement you are currently executing, including mid-task additions; preserve pending original deliverables unless the user cancels them. The framework-injected task_anchor is the sole authoritative anchor and is read-only to the model: never create, copy, rewrite, or nest task_anchor tags in key_info. Remove such tags from old notes when updating, retaining only valid progress facts. Don't store ephemeral info, obvious context, or obsolete progress from a different task.

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Interrupt task to ask user when needing decisions, extra info, or facing unresolvable blockers. Multiple questions should in one call

question.description: For multiple questions, one per line (contain candidates)

candidates.description: Optional quick-select choices for a single question only. Leave empty for multi-questions

function.name: start_long_term_update
function.description: Final memory-settlement marker. Call only after the task is genuinely complete and all necessary memory reads/writes have already finished. This is the LAST tool call: after it returns, the main agent loop enters a bounded memory-only settlement (up to 8 turns), then terminates; no done hooks or ordinary tools can restart the task.

function.name: ocr
function.description: Extract text from a local image using a LOCAL OCR engine (rapidocr/easyocr/tesseract). Never calls any cloud or vision model; no credentials involved. If the image needs visual understanding beyond raw text, ask the user to attach the image to their message instead.

image_path.description: Image path; relative paths resolve from the agent working directory

function.name: generate_image
function.description: Generate an image with the configured image model and save it under image/ in the agent working directory. size and quality are passed through to the upstream API.

quality.description: Upstream quality parameter; defaults to auto

function.name: memory_search
function.description: Search the source-verified layered memory sidecar. Files remain authoritative; zvec is rebuildable and lexical fallback is automatic.

include_l4.description: Include L4 raw sessions when layers are omitted
